field_edits.updated_text: Vertebral body heights and alignment are maintained. No fracture or listhesis.
Severe disc space narrowing at L5-S1. Moderate disc space narrowing at L4-L5 and from T12-L1 through L2-L3.

Small multilevel marginal osteophytes are present. Moderate facet joint arthropathy at L5-S1. Atherosclerotic calcification of the abdominal aorta. Mild to moderate osteoarthritis of both hips and sacroiliac joints.
